note: Non-functional requirements inferred from observable behaviour and configuration in product/. These describe what the code currently does, not necessarily formal targets the business committed to — confirm/adjust with the human.

requirements.requirement: Scroll handlers gate React state updates behind requestAnimationFrame (e.g. the navbar scroll listener), so scroll-driven UI reconciles at most once per rendered frame rather than on every scroll pixel.
requirements.note: Observed in Navbar.tsx; the Services/Methodology canvases are also scroll-driven and animate on rAF.

requirements.requirement: The Services 86-frame image sequence loads the first frame immediately to unblock the UI and lazy-loads the remaining frames in background batches, and only signals asset-readiness (to dismiss the loading overlay) once ready.
requirements.note: Inferred from the Services scroll-frame feature and App's isAssetsReady gating.

requirements.requirement: Production nginx caches Vite hashed /assets/ for 1 year as public, immutable, and the /frames/ Services sequence for 30 days; all non-asset routes fall back to index.html (SPA routing).
Animations and motion respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting (motion intensity is reduced), and interactive/icon elements carry aria labels / aria-hidden where appropriate.
requirements.note: prefers-reduced-motion / aria usage observed across Hero and multiple section/layout components; depth of coverage not exhaustively audited.

requirements.requirement: The contact form validates client-side only: Contact Person, Company and Business Email are required and email must match a basic pattern; there is no server-side validation in this codebase (submission is handed to the Web3Forms third party).
requirements.note: Observed in Contact.tsx validate(); message is capped at 300 chars via maxLength.

requirements.requirement: A top-level React error boundary catches render-time errors and shows a branded recovery screen with a reload action instead of a blank page.
Error diagnostics are limited to console logging (the ErrorBoundary logs caught errors to the console); there is no external error-tracking, analytics, or logging service wired up.
requirements.note: No Sentry/analytics/logging integration found in the code.

requirements.requirement: The document head is populated with title, description, keywords, Open Graph, and Twitter card metadata via react-helmet-async, with sensible defaults and prerender-friendly SPA fallback.
requirements.note: Observed in SEO.tsx; note the site is a client-rendered SPA, so crawler coverage depends on the crawler executing JS.

requirements.requirement: The Web3Forms access_key is embedded as a client-side string literal and the WhatsApp number is hard-coded; there are no server secrets in the app runtime. External links use rel="noopener noreferrer".
requirements.note: The exposed Web3Forms key is inherent to its client-side form-to-email model but is worth confirming with the human; see also the integrations draft.
